Namespace ShapeEngine.Stats

Classes

SimpleStat

Represents a simple stat with a base value and modifiers that affect it. Use SimpleStat When:

  • Small-scale games: Mobile puzzle game with 3-5 stats
  • Prototypes: Quick iteration, don't need polish
  • Isolated systems: One-off calculations, temporary stats
  • Performance-critical: Thousands of stat instances updated per frame
  • No UI needs: Players don't need to see "why" values are what they are

For are more advanced systems, use StatSet.

StackableStatModifierSource

Represents a timed source whose modifiers scale by stack count.

Stat

Represents one calculated stat.

StatModifierSource

Represents a permanent or manually removed source of stat modifiers.

StatSet

Manages stats and their active modifier sources. This is the new entry point of the stat system. You create stats, add modifier sources, call Update(dt) each frame if you have timed effects, and read the final stat values back out.

  • Holds Stat objects and IStatModifierSource (like StatModifierSource, TimedStatModifierSource, StackableStatModifierSource)
  • Formula: ((Base + Flat) * (1 + AdditivePercent)) * MultiplicativeFactor
TimedStatModifierSource

Represents a modifier source that expires after a duration.

StatId

StatModifier
